subject: Re: MAP checkpoint — Integration gating & interop owners
messages:
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Laura Chen <laura.chen@skylarkhealth.com>, Ben Carter <ben@skylarkhealth.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-13T10:12:00Z
Subject: MAP kickoff and gating for SDK/API interop (week 1)

Laura / Ben — thanks again for the demo yesterday. Per our MAP, we want to lock the integration gating and clarify owners so your team can start the end-to-end evaluation next week. High-level asks here: 

- Confirm auth type (OAuth2 mtls vs API key) for the streaming endpoints by EOD Thu 9/16.
- Redwood to provide a lightweight streaming adapter (Node + Python examples) and an auth handshake diagram by Mon 9/20.
- Define success criteria for the eval: latency < 200ms on chat p50, and embedding throughput 100 reqs/s for a 1k token budget.

Attached: initial MAP spreadsheet (v1.3) with milestones and a draft owner matrix. I'll schedule a quick 30m sync for Friday to lock the gating.

Thanks,
Mina Haddad
Senior Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
——
Attachments: MAP_Skylark_v1.3.xlsx (spreadsheet), streaming-adapter-spec.md (spec stub)
From: Laura Chen <laura.chen@skylarkhealth.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@skylarkhealth.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-14T14:07:00Z
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff and gating for SDK/API interop (week 1)

Thanks Mina — this is clear. Quick answers and notes: 

- Auth: we prefer OAuth2 with mTLS for production; can start with API keys for the eval but need the mtls plan before prod. Decision: declared "API key" for eval, target mtls for roll to prod.
- Success criteria: agreed on the latency/throughput targets. We'll add SLA sensitivity for p95 as a secondary metric.
- Owners: I'll be the org lead; Ben will handle platform-side wiring.

Ben, can your infra team test the Node adapter once Mina's examples are available? We can meet Fri 9/17 at 10:00 PT to make the final gating decision.

Laura
Platform PM, Skylark Health

Subject: Re: MAP kickoff and gating for SDK/API interop (week 1) — tech notes

Quick update from the runtime/SDK side: 

- Streaming adapter: Node example ready (streaming-adapter-node.zip referenced in Drive). Python example targeted for Mon 9/20.
- Auth handshake: attached PNG shows the proposed mTLS handshake and token exchange flow. If Skylark wants API key for the eval, we'll include a short-lived key path.
- Tool-calling: we can surface tool-call metadata via a structured metadata header (x-rw-tool) to keep routing deterministic; we'll include a sample payload in the adapter.

Open items for gating: 
1) Certificate exchange process for mTLS (owner: Ben, due 2026-09-22)
2) Test harness for streaming p50/p95 (owner: Vivek, due 2026-09-21)

I'll upload the streaming-adapter-spec.md and auth-handshake-sequence.png to the shared Drive.

Karthik
Principal Engineer, Serving Runtime

Thanks team — summary from our internal sync (9/17): 

- We validated Node adapter end-to-end on a staging cluster. No major blockers.
- Certificate onboarding: we will mirror Redwood's cert rotation cadence; I own the cert exchange and will share the onboarding checklist by Tue 9/21.
- Performance run scheduled: Wed 9/22 02:00–04:00 PT (Vivek to run harness). We expect to validate p50/p95 targets during that window.

Action items we agreed on (condensed):
- Ben: cert exchange checklist + onboarding doc (due 2026-09-21) — attachment requested: auth-handshake-sequence.png included above.
- Vivek: run streaming perf harness and share raw logs + dashboards (due 2026-09-22).
- Mina: update MAP spreadsheet with new gating columns and move sign-off milestone to 9/23 (due 2026-09-20).
- Monica: coordinate procurement if we need short-term dedicated capacity for the perf run (T-shirt sizing by 9/18).

I'll be on the perf window and can handle certificate patching.

—Ben
Engineering Lead, Skylark Health

Subject: Re: MAP checkpoint — gating confirmed, next steps and owners (week 2)

Team — closing out this weekly checkpoint. Notes + updated owner table below (I updated the MAP spreadsheet and requested DocuSign for the MAP addendum).

Meeting notes (9/20):
- Gating: agreed to run eval with API keys; production will require mTLS. Final sign-off after perf window and cert onboarding. Sign-off milestone moved to 9/23 pending perf logs.
- Eval window: perf harness run completed by Vivek on 9/22; if p50/p95 targets met we'll proceed to canary with 1k token limit.
- Tool-calling: Karthik provided sample header; Skylark to confirm tool names for mapping (Ben, due 9/22).

Updated owner table (condensed):
- Certificates / mTLS onboarding: Ben Carter (Skylark) — due 2026-09-21
- Streaming perf harness + logs: Vivek Kulkarni (Redwood) — due 2026-09-22
- MAP spreadsheet update & sign-off chase: Mina Haddad (Redwood) — done 2026-09-20
- Dedicated capacity procurement check: Monica Patel (Redwood) — due 2026-09-18 (T-shirt sizing completed)

Immediate asks to Skylark: 
1) Please confirm the list of tool names you want routed via x-rw-tool by 2026-09-22.
2) Ben — drop the cert checklist link in the Drive folder and ping when certs are staged.

I'll send a short summary to Docs/Sign for the addendum once Ben confirms the checklist link. Thanks all — small, focused week two.

Best,
Mina Haddad
Senior Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
